blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A central challenge in scaling flow models is maintaining stability in training and integration. In flow matching, this stability depends critically on how source samples are paired with data. Independent random pairing introduces substantial stochasticity, motivating minibatch optimal transport (OT) to construct online source-target couplings that reduce this randomness (Tong et al., 2024). However, as applications extend to larger and higher-dimensional datasets, small minibatches can limit these benefits, while scaling the coupling to substantially larger minibatches at every iteration is computationally prohibitive. Moreover, how OT coupling affects the full stochastic gradient and integration remains theoretically unresolved. In this work, we develop a scalable online entropic OT approximation that enables substantially larger source-target couplings while preserving the benefits of OT. We close the theoretical gap for both unregularized and entropic OT by proving strict reductions in full stochastic-gradient variance and integration error relative to independent pairing, and further characterize how these improvements strengthen as the online coupling minibatch grows. Experiments on single-cell gene interpolation-flow and image-flow training validate these predictions, showing that larger online couplings consistently improve training stability and final generation performance.
blocks.zh: 扩大流动模式的一个中心挑战是保持培训和一体化的稳定。 在流量匹配中,这种稳定性主要取决于来源样本如何与数据对接. 独立随机对接引入了实质性的分色性,激发了小批量优化运输(OT)构建可减少这种随机性的在线源-目标耦合(Tong等,2024年)。 然而,随着应用程序扩展到更大型和更高维的数据集,小型小炮管可以限制这些好处,而在每个频率上将接合范围扩大为大得多的小炮管则在计算上令人望而却步。 此外,OT接合如何影响全分层梯度和整合,理论上仍未得到解决。 在这部作品中,我们开发出可伸缩的在线Entropic OT近似,在保留OT的好处的同时,能够使源-目标耦合大大地扩大. 我们通过证明与独立配对相比, 严格减少完全的相位相位差和集成误差, 并进一步描述随着网络接合小批量的增长, 关于单细胞基因内插-流和图像-流训练的实验验证了这些预测,显示更大的在线耦合持续地提高训练稳定性和最终生成性能.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Much of the recent progress in generative AI has been driven by scale. Autoregressive language models benefit from a standardized learning objective: next-token prediction under a softmax distribution. Once this objective is fixed, much of the challenge of scaling shifts to systems and optimization. Flow models introduce an additional dimension: their supervision is constructed along a generative path from noise to data, and the resulting regression targets depend on how source noise samples are coupled with target data samples. Thus, scaling flow models requires consideration not only of how the model is optimized, but also of how its training targets are constructed.
blocks.zh: 近期在遗传性AI方面取得的进展大多由规模驱动. 自动回转语言模型受益于标准化的学习目标:在软最大分布下下进行下接接的预测. 一旦这一目标得到确定,许多挑战就是向系统过渡和优化。 流出模型引入了另一个维度:它们的督导是沿着从噪声到数据的遗传路径构建的,由此产生的回归目标取决于源噪声样本与目标数据样本的结合方式. 因此,规模化流动模式不仅需要考虑如何优化该模式,而且需要考虑如何构建其培训目标。

blocks.en: The choice of such source-target coupling is therefore part of the learning problem itself. In flow matching, each training example pairs a source sample from the noise distribution with a target data sample and regresses the velocity along the resulting interpolation path. Under the standard independent coupling, these pairings are random. Consequently, nearby intermediate states can arise from different endpoint pairs and receive substantially different velocity targets, increasing ambiguity in the regression problem and the variance of stochastic gradients. A natural way to reduce this randomness is to determine the source-target correspondence during training.
blocks.zh: 因此,选择这种源目标结合是学习问题本身的一部分。 在流量匹配中,每个训练例会从噪声分布中将一个源样本与目标数据样本相配并沿所形成的插值路径回溯速度. 在标准的独立耦合下,这些配对是随机的. 因此,相邻的中间状态可能由不同的端点对产生,并获得相去甚远的速度目标,使回归问题的模糊度和相差相去甚远的梯度相去甚远. 减少这种随机性的自然方式是在训练期间确定源-目标通信.

blocks.en: Optimal transport (OT) then provides a natural solution by constructing a coupling between source and target samples within each minibatch during training. Such online coupling minimizes the transport cost between the two empirical distributions, yielding more coherent source-target assignments that induce straighter flows and reduce the ambiguity of independent pairing ( Pooladian et al., 2023 ; Tong et al., 2024 ) . However, as flow matching is applied to larger and more heterogeneous datasets, such as high-dimensional single-cell trajectories and large-scale image datasets, a fixed small coupling minibatch can become increasingly restrictive, where each minibatch only exposes OT to a limited subset of the source and target distributions, constraining the candidate correspondences available at each iteration. As the underlying data distribution grows in diversity and complexity, it therefore becomes natural to scale the OT minibatch accordingly.
blocks.zh: 然后,优化运输(OT)提供了一种自然的解决办法,在培训期间,在每个小批量内构筑出源与目标样品之间的接合。 这种在线耦合将两种经验分布之间的运输成本降至最低,产生更一致的源-目标任务,诱发更直接的流量并减少独立配对的模糊性(Pouladian等,2023;Tong等,2024)。 然而,随着流量匹配被应用于更大型更多样化的数据集,如高维单细胞轨迹和大规模图像数据集,固定的小耦合小批量可以变得日益有限制性,其中每个小批量只使OT暴露在来源和目标分布的有限子集中,限制每个迭代时可用的候选通信. 随着基础数据分布的多样性和复杂性的增加,因此自然会相应扩大OT小批量。

blocks.en: Still, scaling the minibatch size is computationally challenging, where dense pairwise interactions in standard OT restrict practical minibatches to hundreds of samples. Nevertheless, recent advances in scalable entropic OT make substantially larger contexts accessible. In particular, FlashSinkhorn ( Ye et al., 2026 ) implements Sinkhorn iterations with FlashAttention-style HBM kernels without materializing the full coupling matrix in high-bandwidth memory. To this end, we propose a simple, tractable approximation by replacing online OT coupling with scalable entropic OT, enabling coupling contexts to grow from hundreds to thousands of samples during training.
blocks.zh: 尽管如此,缩放小批量体积在计算上仍具有挑战性,在标准OT中密集的对偶相互作用将实用小批量体限制在上百个样本. 然而,最近在可伸缩的东北大西洋的进展使环境大得多。 尤其是FlashSinkhorn(Ye等,2026年)用FlashAttenty风格的HBM内核执行Sinkhorn迭代,而不会在高带宽记忆中实现完整的耦合矩阵. 为此,我们提出一个简单,可牵引的近似方法,用可伸缩的亚热带OT取代在线OT接合,使接合环境在训练期间从上百个样本增长到上千个样本.

blocks.en: The price of this tractability is that entropic regularization changes the coupling itself. The regularization strength ε \varepsilon controls this deviation from standard OT, while the minibatch size k k controls the scale of the online coupling. Understanding whether the stability benefits of OT persist therefore requires characterizing the joint effects of regularization and coupling scale. Moreover, this question remains unresolved even for standard unregularized minibatch OT. Existing analyses motivate OT through straighter paths and reduced conditional uncertainty ( Pooladian et al., 2023 ; Boïté et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Chambolle and Hertrich, 2026 ) , but do not provide a general strict characterization of its effect on the full stochastic-gradient variance or the induced numerical integration error.
blocks.zh: 这种可牵引性的价格是,亚热带正规化会改变接合本身. 规范化强度 \\ varepsilon 控制着与标准OT的这一偏差,而小批量大小 k k 控制着在线耦合的尺度. 因此,要了解OT的稳定利益是否继续存在,就必须说明正规化和结合规模的共同影响。 此外,即使对于标准的非正规小批量OT来说,这个问题仍未得到解决。 现有分析激励OT通过更直的路径并减少有条件的不确定性(Pouladian等,2023;Boïté等,2026;Zhang等,2026;Chambolle和Hertrich,2026;),但没有对其对全分位相差或所引发的数值整合误差的影响提供一般的严格定性.

blocks.en: By making larger online couplings feasible, we determine whether their stability benefits survive the approximation required for scaling. Our contributions can be summarized below:
blocks.zh: 通过让更大的在线接合成为可行,我们确定它们的稳定收益是否在规模化所需的近似值上幸存. 我们的贡献可概述如下:

blocks.en: We provide a unified and principled characterization of how online OT coupling affects optimization and numerical integration. On the optimization side, we characterize the full stochastic-gradient variance by (i) proving that population quadratic OT strictly reduces this variance relative to independent coupling, (ii) showing that unregularized minibatch-OT variance reduces as the minibatch size k k grows, and (iii) extending same guarantees to entropic-regularized couplings. On the integration side, we establish parallel strict reductions in Euler integration error and characterize how these guarantees improve with scaled minibatch size. These results provide a better theoretical understanding for using and scaling entropic OT as a replacement to the standard online OT couplings.
blocks.zh: 我们对在线OT组合如何影响优化和数字整合提供了统一的原则性特征。 在优化方面,我们将完全的分层-分层差异定性为:(一) 证明人口四相OT相对于独立耦合严格减少这种差异;(二) 显示非常规小批量-OT差异随着小批量kk的增大而减少;(三) 将同样的保障范围扩大到热带-正规化组合。 在一体化方面,我们同时严格减少欧拉一体化错误,并描述这些保证如何随着小批量的扩大而得到改善。 这些结果为使用和缩放亚热带OT作为标准在线OT耦合的替代品提供了更好的理论理解.

blocks.en: OT-based conditional flow matching (OT-CFM) improves both training and generation through better source-target pairings ( Tong et al., 2024 ; Pooladian et al., 2023 ) . Given the difficulty to scale OT-CFM, recent works scale the minibatch context by separating pairing from training: Zhang et al. (2026) precomputed million-scale couplings offline, which requires buffering enough pairs to cover the entire training run before optimization begins; semidiscrete approximation methods offer better efficiency by reusing fitted dataset-level potentials, but need a separate potential-optimization stage ( Mousavi-Hosseini et al., 2026 ) or face non-convergence when scaled to large unconditional datasets ( Kong et al., 2026 ) . Therefore, we return to the original challenge, by finding an affordable and stable method for scaling the minibatch that flow matching recomputes from fresh samples at every training iteration.
blocks.zh: 基于OT的有条件流量匹配(OT-CFM)通过更好的源目标配对改进了培训和生成(Tong等,2024;Pouladian等,2023.). 由于OT-CFM的缩放难度很大,近期的作品通过将配对与培训区分开来来缩放小批量语境: Zhang等人(2026年)预计算出百万个规模的耦合线下线,这需要缓冲足够一对,在优化开始前覆盖整个训练运行;半分相近方法通过再用装配的数据集水平潜力来提供更好的效率,但需要单独的潜能-优化阶段(Mousavi-Hosseini等,2026年),或者在缩放为大型无条件数据集时面临非相近(Kong等,2026年). 因此,我们回到最初的挑战,找到一种负担得起和稳定的方法,在每次训练迭代时,都从新鲜样品中重新计算出流动相匹配的小批量。

blocks.en: The existing theory has so far addressed separate pieces. Tong et al. (2024) connect population OT to dynamic OT, while Pooladian et al. (2023) study conditional gradient covariance and asymptotic BatchOT straightness. Finite-batch theory remains limited: Zhang et al. (2026) characterize uncertainty in the resulting OT coupling, while Boïté et al. (2026) analyze its integration benefit only in a restricted two-atom model; more recent work also studies full parameter-gradient variance in restricted Gaussian models ( Reu et al., 2025 ) and integration error through the geometry of a prescribed velocity field ( Tao and Choi, 2026 ) . Thus, no prior result establishes that replacing independent pairing with minibatch OT strictly reduces full stochastic-gradient variance while inducing a general integration advantage; we defer further related work to Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 现有的理论到目前为止已经处理了不同的部分. 汤等. (2024年)将人口OT与动态OT相接,而Pouladian等(2023年)则研究有条件的梯度共变和不对称的BatchOT直径. 有限批量理论仍然有限: Zhang等人(2026年)对由此产生的OT耦合的不确定性进行了定性,而Boïté等人(2026年)仅以受限制的二原子模型分析其结合效益;更近期的工作还研究了受限制的高斯模型(Reu等人,2025年)中的全部参数梯度差异和通过规定速度场的几何来进行结合错误(Tao和Choi,2026年). 因此,没有事先的结果确定,用小批量OT取代独立配对可严格地减少完全的分层-分层差异,同时带来一般的一体化优势;我们将进一步的相关工作推迟到附录A。

3 Scalable OT for Flow Matching
blocks.zh: 3 流动匹配可缩放OT

blocks.en: We refer to our method as conditional flow matching with entropic OT (EOT-CFM). Our approach applies a larger context of source and target samples to construct better couplings, with FlashSinkhorn ( Ye et al., 2026 ) enabling efficient computation at scale. Specifically, at each training iteration, we draw fresh source and target minibatches, compute an approximate entropic transport plan, and sample source-target pairs from this plan to form the regression batch.
blocks.zh: 我们称我们的方法为有条件的流量相匹配于热带OT(EOT-CFM). 我们的方法采用了更大的来源和目标样本背景来构建更好的组合,FlashSinkhorn(Ye等,2026年)使得能够进行规模高效计算。 具体地说,在每次训练迭接时,我们绘制出新的源头并瞄准微型炮管,计算出一个大致的演算式运输计划,并从这个计划中取出样本的源头-目标对来组成回归批次.

blocks.en: 4.1 On stochastic gradient variance
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 斜向梯度差异

blocks.en: We first study the benefit of scaling OT minibatch size through its effect on stochastic-gradient variance. The closest existing result we are aware of is Pooladian et al. (2023, Lemma 3.2) , which analyzes the conditional gradient variance of minibatch OT at model input ( t , x ) (t,x) , corresponding to the fixed-input component in Eq. 1 . However, it remains a gap to prove that OT coupling strictly reduces the stochastic-gradient variance relative to independent coupling.
blocks.zh: 我们首先研究通过缩放OT小批量对分层-分层差异的影响来缩小其大小的好处。 我们知道的现有最接近的结果是Pouladian等人(2023年,Lemma 3.2年),该结果分析了模型输入(t, x) (t, x)时小批量OT的有条件梯度差异,与Eq. 1中的固定输入部分相对应. 然而,要证明OT接合会严格减少相对于独立接合的分层-分层差异,仍然是个漏洞.

blocks.en: Therefore, in § 4.1.1 , we begin by establishing a strict gradient-variance reduction by filling the gap between optimal coupling π ⋆ \pi^{\star} and independent coupling π ind \pi_{\text{ind}} . In § 4.1.2 , we extend this result to entropic-OT couplings. Finally, in § 4.1.3 , we establish that scaling to larger minibatch size could further reduce gradient variance for both unregularized and entropic OT couplings.

blocks.zh: 4.1.1 逐步减少差异:标准非正规化OT

blocks.en: We first state two standard assumptions used in theoretical analyses of flow matching and neural differential equations: realizability of the population target field and global optimality of the population objective ( Islam et al., 2026 ; Khan et al., 2026 ; Baheri, 2026 ) . blocks.en: We study three classes of experiments to show the empirical benefits of scaling minibatch size: (i) first, we consider classical 2D synthetic datasets, where the effects of minibatch scaling can be clearly visualized and interpreted; (ii) we then work on single-cell interpolation flows; apart from the traditional medium-dimensional dataset used in OT-CFM, we include a large-scale, high-dimensional dataset to demonstrate the benefits of scaled minibatches; (iii) finally, we evaluate image flow training on CIFAR-100 ( Krizhevsky, 2009 ) and ImageNet-64 × \times 64 ( Deng et al., 2009 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们研究了三类实验,以显示缩放小批量大小的经验效益:(一)首先,我们考虑古典的2D合成数据集,其中可以清晰地可视化并解释出小批量放大的效果;(二)然后我们研究单细胞内插流;除了OT-CFM中使用的传统中维数据集外,我们还包括一个大规模高维数据集来展示缩放小批量的效益;(三)最后,我们评价关于CIFAR-100(Krizhevsky,2009年)和ImageNet-64×\ties 64(Deng等,2009年)的图像流培训.

blocks.en: We consider two synthetic problems: a symmetric problem with 64 64 Gaussian modes arranged on an 8 × 8 8\times 8 grid, and a double-ring problem with 8 8 modes on each ring. In both problems, the source and target distributions are separated by a horizontal translation, and the ground-truth coupling matches points with the same mode label. We compare independent coupling, OT-CFM with a 128 × 128 128\times 128 minibatch, and EOT with context sizes n ∈ { 512 , 2048 , 8192 } n\in\{512,2048,8192\} , using squared Euclidean cost and training a three-layer MLP for 6,000 6{,}000 updates with batch size 128 128 with AdamW.

blocks.en: Results are shown in Figure 1 . Specifically, larger OT contexts produce increasingly coherent source-target pairings, as shown by the reduction in red suboptimal crossing connections and the increase in green optimal coupling connections. This improvement directly translates into lower SGD variance, with tighter projected-gradient distributions that shows scaling the OT context provides cleaner pairings and substantially better training stability. More 2D examples are provided in Appendix C .

We leave out each intermediate time point t ∈ { 1 , 2 , 3 } t\in\{1,2,3\} , train a three-layer MLP of width 64 64 on the remaining transitions for at most 1,000 1{,}000 epochs.

blocks.en: For PBMC, we use 90,452 90{,}452 PBS control cells and 20,471 20{,}471 IFN- β \beta -stimulated cells from Donor 1, represent each cell using 100 100 whitened principal components, and apply the same data split. We train a three-layer MLP of width 256 256 for 100,000 100{,}000 steps. Both experiments use AdamW with learning rate 10 − 3 10^{-3} , weight decay 10 − 5 10^{-5} , and a regression batch size of 128 128 , and generate cells using 100 100 Euler steps. For EB, we report exact W 1 W_{1} averaged over three held-out time points and five seeds. For PBMC, we compare 2,048 2{,}048 generated and held-out target cells and report exact assignment W 1 W_{1} , CellFlow energy, and gradient variance, averaged over five seeds. Results are presented in Table 1 . Since the smallest time point from EB contains around 1900 cells, the maximum minibatch cannot be scaled as PBMC. For both dataset, larger minibatch leads to both better empirical performance and more stable training, where the improvement consistently gets better with larger minibatch size. With the result deferred to Appendix C , we also use the high dimensional PBMC dataset to study the ablation over ε \varepsilon , moderate thousands-level context already gives a clear effect of scaling and remains robust to the entropic regularization intensity.

For CIFAR, all methods follow the same U-Net architecture and optimization hyperparameters from OT-CFM’s CIFAR training script ( Tong et al., 2024 ) . blocks.en: For ImageNet training, we follow the unconditional ADM-style U-Net configuration of Pooladian et al. (2023) . We train for 500,000 500{,}000 updates with a global batch size of 1,024 1{,}024 across 8 × \times NVIDIA H100 GPUs and a constant learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} . Similar to CIFAR-100, all coupling methods share the same architecture and training configuration, and we generate 50,000 50{,}000 samples from the EMA checkpoint and report FID against the canonical ADM ImageNet-64 reference statistics. Evaluation results are shown in Table 2 , and we further present in-training gradient variance and qualitative image generation results in Figure 3 . Experiments on both single-cell and image flow matching show that larger coupling minibatches generally reduce gradient variance and improve performance, consistent with our entropic analysis in § 4.1.3 . Figure 3 further shows that the gains in generation quality are particularly better at low NFEs. Together, these findings suggest that scaling the entropic coupling context benefits both optimization and sampling, combining lower gradient noise during training with better generation quality under limited integration budgets.

blocks.en: Thanks to its bandwidth-efficient design and compatibility with PyTorch/Triton over HBM GPUs, FlashSinkhorn integrates naturally into efficient FM training. Increasing the minibatch size incurs only a modest increase in peak GPU memory. On ImageNet, the standard OT-CFM baseline reaches a peak memory usage of 39.96 GB, while FlashSinkhorn with a coupling size of 10K uses only 41.08 GB. For runtime, even at the largest context 10K, full OT coupling and pair sampling wall time account for less than 10 % 10\% of the total time per gradient optimization step. The measured coupling latency is approximately 0.03 seconds at the 4K context and around 0.08 seconds at the 8K context. In addition to the benefit brought by entropic regularization, FlashAttention-style engineering also offers efficient GPU kernels, the native PyTorch integration removes the need for PyTorch-JAX tensor interchange and coordination between separate execution and memory-management runtimes, keeping coupling computation and pair sampling within the flow-matching optimization loop.
blocks.zh: 由于在HBM GPU上具有带宽高效的设计并和PyTorch/Triton兼容,FlashSinkhorn自然融入了高效的FM训练. 增加"小批量"的尺寸只会引起峰值GPU内存的适度增加. 在ImageNet上,标准OT-CFM基线达到了39.96GB的峰值内存使用率,而相接大小为10K的FlashSinkhorn仅使用41.08GB. 就运行时间而言,即使是在最大的上下文10K,完全OT接合和成对采样墙壁时间占每个梯度优化步骤总时间的不到10%-10%. 测量到的耦合延迟为4K上下文约0.03秒,而8K上下文约0.08秒. 除了由entropic正规化带来的效益外,FlashAttenty-tyle工程还提供高效的GPU内核,本土PyTorch集成消除了PyTorch-JAX lomor交换和单独执行和内存管理运行时间之间的协调需求,在流量匹配优化循环中保持了相接计算和对子采样.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we study online coupling as a fundamental scaling axis for flow matching and fill the gap by establishing a strict reduction in full stochastic-gradient variance from independent pairing to population OT, characterize how larger online minibatch couplings recover this advantage, and extend the analysis to entropically regularized OT together with parallel guarantees for integration error. These results motivate a scalable approximation based on large online entropic couplings. Across both cell flow and image flow experiments, scaling the online coupling consistently improves training stability and generation quality. In the end, our results provide both a principled theoretical framework for rigorously analyzing the concrete effect brought by the more informative couplings and simple yet practical foundation for scaling flow matching.

blocks.en: Normalizing flows and neural ODEs provide the modeling background for flow matching ( Rezende and Mohamed, 2015 ; Chen et al., 2018 ) , while flow matching and rectified flow introduce regression-based objectives for learning continuous transport dynamics ( Lipman et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023 ) . More broadly, minibatch Wasserstein objectives have been studied as stochastic surrogates for population OT, including their asymptotic and gradient properties ( Fatras et al., 2020 ) ; these results concern the minibatch transport objective itself rather than using its random plan as flow-matching supervision. Tong et al. (2024) introduce OT-CFM and connect the population OT coupling to dynamic OT, whereas Pooladian et al. (2023) analyze gradient covariance conditional on a fixed model input and establish asymptotic BatchOT straightness and transport-cost convergence.
blocks.zh: 使流量和神经电平规范化为流量匹配提供了模型背景(Rezende and Mohamed, 2015;Chen等, 2018),而流量匹配和修正流量则引入了基于回归的学习连续运输动态的目标(Lipman等, 2023;Liu等, 2023). 更广泛地说,小批量瓦瑟施泰因目标被作为人口OT的花样代用物加以研究,包括它们的不对称性和梯度性(Fatras等,2020年;这些结果涉及小批量运输目标本身,而不是将其随机计划用作流量匹配监督. 汤等. (2024)引入OT-CFM,将人口OT相接与动态OT相接,而Pouladian等人(2023年)则分析梯度共变性,以固定模型输入为条件,建立不对称的BatchOT直径与运输成本趋同.

blocks.en: Very recent work characterizes limit points of Reflow combined with fixed-size minibatch OT through cyclical monotonicity and straightness properties ( Chambolle and Hertrich, 2026 ) ; we note that this concerns repeated Reflow rather than the optimization or integration behavior of a single online minibatch-CFM objective.

(2026) scales Sinkhorn couplings to millions of samples through an offline construction, where paired samples are precomputed independently of model training and served through an augmented data loader. We note that their finite-batch lower bound motivates increasing coupling size, but it does not establish a strict OT-versus-independent comparison or a full stochastic-gradient result. Boïté et al. (2026) characterize the expected exact-OT batch plan and its transport-cost convergence, while their integration result is restricted to an exact velocity field in a one-dimensional two-atom model, and they also show that when the population OT plan is unique, π ^ k \widehat{\pi}_{k} converges weakly to π ⋆ \pi^{\star} , i.e., π ^ k → k → ∞ 𝑤 π ⋆ \widehat{\pi}_{k}\xrightarrow[k\to\infty]{\,w\,}\pi^{\star} . However, we note that this coupling-level convergence does not imply any level of convergence for stochastic gradient variance.

blocks.en: Semidiscrete methods instead construct dataset-level noise-data alignments, avoiding a fresh discrete OT solve at every iteration ( Mousavi-Hosseini et al., 2026 ; Kong et al., 2026 ) . Calvo-Ordonez et al. (2025) replace minibatch OT with Gibbs-weighted independent pairs, avoiding an explicit OT solve but potentially altering the marginals, so larger minibatches provide more weighted pairs rather than scaling a larger candidate pool for optimizing source-target assignments. Our setting instead retains online couplings recomputed from fresh minibatches, with clear scaling benefits merely to thousand-level of minibatch size.
blocks.zh: Semidicrete方法相反地构建了数据集级噪声数据对接,避免了每次迭接时出现新鲜的离散OT解(Mousavi-Hosseini等,2026;Kong等,2026.). Calvo-Ordonez等 (2025)用吉布斯加权的独立配对取代了小批量OT,避免了明显的OT解而有可能改变边际,因此更大的微型批量为优化源目标任务提供了更多的加权配对,而不是规模更大的候选配对. 我们的设置则保留了从新鲜小枪口重现的在线接合器, 其清晰的缩放效益仅可达到千米大小。

blocks.en: Brenier’s characterization motivates representing quadratic-cost OT maps as gradients of convex potentials ( Brenier, 1991 ) , for which input-convex neural networks provide a convenient parameterization ( Amos et al., 2017 ) . This approach has been used to learn OT maps, plans, and Wasserstein barycenters ( Makkuva et al., 2020 ; Korotin et al., 2021a ; Fan et al., 2021 ; Korotin et al., 2021b ; Korotin et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Asadulaev et al., 2024 ) . Within flow matching, optimal flow matching constrains the velocity parameterization to recover the population quadratic-OT displacement directly ( Kornilov et al., 2024 ) . These methods learn a population-level map or plan through model structure or a separate neural optimization problem, rather than analyzing the random coupling recomputed from each flow-training minibatch.
blocks.zh: Brenier的特征描述代表了四相成本的OT地图作为对流潜力的梯度(Brenier,1991年),为此输入-对流神经网络提供了一个方便的参数化(Amos等,2017年). 这一方法被用于学习OT地图、计划以及Wasserstein barycenters(Makkuva等,2020年;Korotin等,2021a; Fan等,2021;Korotin等,2021b;Korotin等,2023;Chen等,2024;Asadulaev等,2024. 在流量匹配范围内,优化流量匹配会限制速度参数化,以直接恢复人口四相-OT迁移(Kornilov等,2024年). 这些方法通过模型结构或单独的神经优化问题来学习人口级地图或计划,而不是分析从每个流量训练小批量中随机重算的耦合.

blocks.en: Reu et al. (2025) analyze the variance of the full parameter gradient in restricted Gaussian transport models under specific analytic velocity parameterizations, and show that low gradient variance can also coexist with undesirable deterministic pairings. We note that these results do not associate independent pairing with random online minibatch OT in a general model class. For numerical integration, Tao and Choi (2026) decompose the velocity Jacobian into strain and vorticity and establish favorable Euler properties for exact OT displacement fields. This analysis concerns the geometry of a given velocity field rather than an integration-error ordering induced by finite minibatch couplings. Thus, neither line characterizes how full-gradient variance and integration error jointly change with coupling size and entropic regularization.
blocks.zh: Reu等 (2025)分析在特定分析速度参数化下限制高斯运输模型中全参数梯度的差异,并显示低梯度差异也可以与不理想的定型配对并存. 我们注意到,这些结果并没有将独立配对与一般模型类的随机在线小批量OT联系起来。 为了进行数字整合,陶和崔(2026年)将速度雅各比亚人分解为紧张和漩涡,并为准确的OT迁移地建立有利的欧拉地产. 这一分析涉及特定速度场的几何,而不是由有限小批量接合所引发的集成-过速令. 因此,两行都无法说明全相位相差和集成误差如何与接合大小和亚热带正规化共同变化。

blocks.en: Entropic regularization makes discrete OT amenable to Sinkhorn matrix scaling ( Cuturi, 2013 ) . Subsequent work establishes approximation-complexity guarantees for Sinkhorn, Greenkhorn, accelerated variants, and multimarginal extensions ( Altschuler et al., 2017 ; Lin et al., 2019 ; Lin et al., 2022 ) , while POT provides widely used implementations ( Flamary et al., 2021 ) . FlashSinkhorn targets GPU efficiency by fusing Sinkhorn updates and avoiding materialization of the full coupling matrix in high-bandwidth memory ( Ye et al., 2026 ) , along with prior results with scaled dotproduct attention for onesided EOT problem ( Litman, 2025 ) and later extension with improved learning prior ( Litman and Guo, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: Entrophic regulation使离散的OT适合Sinkhorn矩阵缩放(Cuturi,2013年)。 随后的工作为辛克霍恩,格林克霍恩,加速变种和多边延伸设定了近似-复杂性保障(Altschuler等,2017;Lin等,2019;Lin等,2022;),而POT则提供被广泛使用的执行(Flamary等,2021). FlashSinkhorn针对GPU的效率,方法是将Sinkhorn的更新相接并避免在高带宽内存中实现完整的耦合矩阵(Ye等,2026年),以及之前的结果,对片面的EOT问题(Litman,2025年)的多产品关注被放大,后来随着前期学习的改进(Litman和Guo,2026年)被扩展.

blocks.en: For finite linear programs, Weed (2018) give explicit non-asymptotic guarantees for convergence of entropically penalized solutions toward unregularized optima. At the population level, EOT potentials, plans, and costs converge toward their unregularized counterparts as ε → 0 \varepsilon\to 0 ( Nutz and Wiesel, 2022 ; Malamut and Sylvestre, 2025 ) . Statistical results establish parametric sample-complexity bounds at fixed regularization ( Rigollet and Stromme, 2025 ) , limit distributions when regularization decreases with sample size ( Mordant, 2024 ) , and finite-sample bias and variance bounds with explicit dependence on regularization and intrinsic dimension ( González-Sanz et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 对于有限的线性方案,Wed(2018年)明确提供非症状性保障,使受到非正统惩罚的解决方案趋于一致。 在人口一级,EOT的潜力、计划和费用与未正规化的对应方趋同,分别为: ^ ^ 0\ varepsilon\\0 (Nutz and Wiesel, 2022; Malamut and Sylvestre, 2025)。 统计结果确定了固定正规化时的参数化样本-复杂性界限(Rigollet和Stromme, 2025年),在规范化随着样本大小(Mordant, 2024年)减少时限制分布,以及明确依赖正规化和内在维度的有限样本-样本偏差和差异界限(González-Sanz等, 2026年)。

blocks.en: We provide additional experimental results and details. First, we present additional 2D synthetic experiment on rings in Figure 4 , using the same training settings as the multimodal block synthetic experiment in Figure 1 . The results show a similar conclusion, where larger minibatch sizes consistently lead to more stable training and lower flow-generation error.
blocks.zh: 我们提供更多的实验结果和细节。 首先,我们在图4中增加了2D合成实验,使用与图1中的多模式块合成实验相同的训练设置。 结果显示类似的结论,较大的小批量尺寸一直导致更稳定的培训和更低的流量生成出错.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Ablation over ε \varepsilon on the PBMC dataset with an 8K entropic OT context, with the exact W 1 W_{1} error of generated samples (left) and training gradient variance (right) shown. We sweep ε \varepsilon from { 0.0025 , 0.0015 , 0.001 , 0.0009 , 0.00075 , 0.0006 , 0.0005 , 0.0004 , 0.00025 , 0.0001 } \{0.0025,0.0015,0.001,0.0009,0.00075,0.0006,0.0005,0.0004,0.00025,0.0001\} .

We also ablate ε \varepsilon on the PBMC dataset, whose size lets us reach substantially larger minibatch contexts than the EB dataset. Offline pipelines that scale to million-level contexts must drive ε \varepsilon to very low levels to keep the coupling sharp, which makes its tuning delicate. Online couplings instead pair each freshly sampled source point within the current minibatch, so that a moderate context of a few thousand points already yields a clear scaling effect while remaining robust to the choice of ε \varepsilon .
blocks.zh: 我们还放弃了 PBMC 数据集上的 \\ varepsilon, 其大小让我们到达比 EB 数据集大得多的小批量背景 。 连接到百万级环境的离线管道必须把 \\ varepsilon 驱动到非常低的水平, 以保持接合的锐度, 这使其调谐变得微妙。 网络组合将当前小批量中每个新采样的源点对齐,这样,几千分的温和上下文就已经产生明显的缩放效果,同时保持稳健到\\\ varepsilon的选择.

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 5 , we sweep ε \varepsilon from 0.0001 0.0001 to 0.0025 0.0025 at 8K minibatch entropic OT context. Following the exactly same training configuration detailed in § 5 , each ε \varepsilon trial is running over 5 seeds, with the mean performance and its standard deviation shown. Performance peaks around ε = 0.001 \varepsilon=0.001 and varies little across the swept range. For EB training, we use a constant ε = 0.01 \varepsilon=0.01 across all context sizes, since the largest context can only be scaled to 1.5K. For image flow training, where the context can be scaled similarly to PBMC, the optimal ε \varepsilon at the largest minibatch context is 0.002 0.002 for CIFAR and 0.001 0.001 for ImageNet, consistent with the 8K-context ablation.
